title: Codimension of a coordinate-zero subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be a set of coordinates among $n$ coordinates. The dimension of the orthogonal complement, under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$, of the subspace of vectors vanishing on every coordinate in $S$ is $|S|$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $S$ of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
